text:
liz: Heads-up 10: Cortel wants a short dedicated commit for a POC. Mixed pool (2 H100 + 4 A100 equiv), 4-week trial but asked pricing for 3 months. They need burst up to 4x baseline during weekly load tests. Asking for a 25% burst discount and a provisional credit cap.
omar: Do we have baseline numbers?
liz: Baseline is ~30 H100-eq hrs/day. Spikes ~120 H100-eq hrs/day for ~8 hours during tests. Token est ~800M/mo if we go 3mo.
sarah: They specifically want confirmation we can support customer-managed KMS and tenant isolation in hosted. Legal will want the SOW clause for anonymized PII.
paul: Pricing quick calc (H100-eq terms):
```
unit = $5.75 per H100-hr
baseline_daily = 30 hrs
baseline_month = 30*30 = 900 hrs
spike_extra = (120-30)*8 days ~ 720 hrs (approx monthly)
cost_baseline = 900 * 5.75 = $5,175
cost_spike = 720 * 5.75 * 1.4 (burst markup) = ~$5,796
25% discount on spike ~ $1,449
requested_credit_cap = $18,000
```
paul: Mixed GPU note: A100 ~0.7 H100 cost so need weighted-rate clause.
sarah: Deal-desk: we can provisionally approve with conditions: 1) discount only on incremental burst (not baseline), 2) credit cap $18k, 3) auto-throttle to baseline once cap reached, 4) weighted GPU eq pricing language, 5) non-recurring POC-only clause. Finance sign-off required.
omar: Ops note: auto-throttle + fallback to A100-only pool doable. Will need a one-hour config window.
finance: Finance: provisional ok, contingent on signed SOW and prepayment for first month or a card hold equal to estimated consumption + 20% buffer.
sarah: Legal: include KMS requirements and data handling clause. No raw PII. If they insist, we need Private deployment.
liz: I'll draft the approval request. deal-desk-bot: run `/dealdesk request --customer "Cortel Labs" --thread 1923456789 --amount 18000 --terms "3mo pricing quote for 4wk POC window, 25% incremental burst discount, weighted GPU-eq clause, auto-throttle to baseline on cap, non-recurring"`
paul: Also add explicit line that discount applies only to incremental burst compute above baseline and expires after POC window.
liz: Good call. I'll attach the baseline telemetry and token estimates to the ticket and ping legal/finance for signatures. :white_check_mark:
